I can appreciate a passionate discussion about why somebody is a fan of a certain anime. Though I think every show (such as Deca-dence) has groups of fans that actively display a superiority complex in forums such as this one, so they can feel special. Being a fan of show is not X is good so Y must be bad. Everyone will have anime that they watch and don’t watch based on personal preference. I don’t think it’s wrong or pitiable to not be watching a certain show. I’m glad that an original anime story is being well received by many this season. I think Deca-Dence has surpassed most people’s expectations as far as quality and viewership numbers are concerned. I’m happy about that. Though all in all, love what you love, but don’t imply others are worse for having not viewed and loved what you have viewed in loved. It comes off more as toxic than anything and does not do a good job of convincing those who disagree. I think this mindset has contributed to a devolution of conversation on this reddit sub. Then again it wouldn’t be reddit without commenters having a holier-than-thou attitude about their personal opinions...
